description: This source file defines the PageModel class for the Basket index page in an ASP.NET Razor Pages application. It handles displaying the basket, adding items, updating quantities, and managing user basket identification via cookies and user authentication.

classes.name: IndexModel
classes.description: Page model for managing the shopping basket page, including viewing basket contents, adding items, and updating quantities.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the current user's basket.

methods.name: OnPost
methods.description: Handles POST requests for adding a product to the basket.

methods.name: OnPostUpdate
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update basket item quantities.

methods.name: GetOrSetBasketCookieAndUserName
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a user identifier for the basket, using authentication status or cookies.
